items.title_orig: Pearl Jam - A collection of mostly live recordings, demos, rarities, various artists filler (1990) to 2000.
items.article_text:
Demos: Momma-Son, Brother, Mookie Blaylock, Vs. Two Track Demos.
 Promotional Cassettes: Alive, No Code, Yield U.K.
 Live Shows: Content from ~144 or more live shows from 1990-10-22 to 2000-11-05. The ones from 2000 are AUD and/or deemed inferior to the official sources, same with 1995-07-11 and any other officially released show and are merely provided as supplemental content and because of filler.
 Rarities: Self Pollution Radio I and the even more rare, Self Pollution Radio II from two sources.
 Various Artists Filler: Live, with the exception of an incomplete Ween - Craters of the Sac, per tape ending filler, but there’s some live filler of the Allman Brothers Band, the Jesus Lizard, Stills-Young band, James Taylor, Bad Religion, Marilyn Manson, Goodness, the Replacements, and Misfits.
